name: Streif & Hahnenkamm-Stadion
kurzbeschreibung: The legendary Streif in Kitzbühel is the world's most spectacular downhill ski course, accessible in summer via an interactive themed hiking trail.
preis: Themed trail freely accessible; Hahnenkamm cable car requires ticket (Kitzbüheler Alpen Sommer Card valid)
oeffnungszeiten: Mid-May to early November daily from 08:30 to 17:00; winter ski operations
beschreibung:
Overview

The iconic Streif-Hahnenkamm-Stadion in Kitzbühel is indisputably the world's most famous and spectacular downhill ski racing arena. Every January, the international sports world watches in awe as the world's elite alpine racers plunge down the vertiginous slopes of the Streif during the prestigious Hahnenkamm Races. With a terrifying maximum gradient of 85 percent at the Mausefalle, airborne jumps up to 80 meters, and speeds exceeding 140 km/h, the Streif represents the ultimate test of courage and skill in winter sports. The finish corridor and grandstand arena just above Kitzbühel's historic centre transform into a buzzing celebration ground packed with tens of thousands of fans. In summer, this legendary piste metamorphoses into a scenic alpine playground and themed hiking terrain for sports fans.

Route & Requirements

In summer, mountain hikers can experience the legendary key sections of the original Streif up close along the well-signposted 'Streif live' hiking trail. Ascend effortlessly aboard the Hahnenkammbahn gondola to the mountain station at 1,665 meters. From there, the panoramic trail winds downhill past the historic start house, the dizzying Mausefalle, the steep traverse, and the Hausbergkante cliff down into the finish stadium. Descending the 860 vertical meters (approx. 2.5 hours, graded moderate) requires surefootedness, sound knees, and ankle-high hiking boots with grippy profile soles. Casual walkers can explore the start house and interactive multimedia exhibits on the summit plateau before riding the gondola comfortably back to the valley. Welcoming alpine inns along the way invite hikers to rest.

Visit & Arrival

The Hahnenkammbahn operates daily in summer from mid-May to early November between 08:30 and 17:00; the Kitzbüheler Alpen Sommer Card is accepted. In winter, the Streif is open as a marked ski run for expert skiers, while the family route bypasses the steepest pitches. Motorists arrive via the B161 to Kitzbühel (large car park at the valley station). Train passengers alight directly at Kitzbühel Hahnenkamm station, situated right across from the gondola terminal and finish arena.

Tips

Step inside the glazed start hut on the ridge and peer down into the fearsome precipice of the Mausefalle to grasp the incredible courage of the racers. The Hahnenkamm Panorama Restaurant at the top station serves delicious fluffy Kaiserschmarrn accompanied by sweeping vistas of the Wilder Kaiser.
saison: Mai bis Oktober (Hahnenkammbahn täglich in Betrieb)
